overview.title: Overview
overview.text: At Denis.pt, we are committed to protecting your privacy. This privacy policy explains how we handle information when you visit our website. The short version: we respect your privacy and collect minimal data.

dataCollection.title: Data We Collect
dataCollection.text: We do not collect any personal data through this website. We do not use analytics services, tracking pixels, or any form of user behavior monitoring. When you contact us via email, we only use your information to respond to your inquiry.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.text: This website uses only one essential cookie to remember your cookie consent preference. This cookie is stored locally in your browser and is not sent to any external servers. We do not use any third-party cookies, advertising cookies, or tracking cookies.
cookies.note: Cookie used: 'cookie-consent' - Stores your cookie preference choice. No personal data is collected.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.text: This website does not integrate any third-party services that collect your data. We do not use Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel, or any other tracking or advertising services. The fonts used on this website are loaded from external services (Google Fonts, Fontshare) but these services do not receive any personal information from you.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.text: Under GDPR, you have the right to access, correct, or delete any personal data we may hold about you. Since we do not collect personal data through this website, there is typically no data to access, correct, or delete. If you have contacted us via email, you may request deletion of your correspondence at any time.
